entries.title: Genesis 26:1
segments: ¶Then came a time of great need in the land, like that which had been before in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

entries.title: Genesis 26:2
segments: And the Lord came to him in a vision and said, Do not go down to Egypt; keep in the land of which I will give you knowledge:

entries.title: Genesis 26:3
segments: Keep in this land, and I will be with you and give you my blessing; for to you and to your seed will I give all these lands, giving effect to the oath which I made to your father Abraham;

entries.title: Genesis 26:4
segments: I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and will give them all these lands, and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth;

entries.title: Genesis 26:5
segments: Because Abraham gave ear to my voice and kept my words, my rules, my orders, and my laws.

entries.title: Genesis 26:6
segments: ¶So Isaac went on living in Gerar;

entries.title: Genesis 26:7
segments: And when he was questioned by the men of the place about his wife, he said, She is my sister; fearing to say, She is my wife; for, he said, the men of the place may put me to death on account of Rebekah; because she is very beautiful.

entries.title: Genesis 26:8
segments: And when he had been there for some time, Abimelech, king of the Philistines, looking through a window, saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 26:9
segments: And he said to Isaac, It is clear that she is your wife: why then did you say, She is my sister? And Isaac said, For fear that I might be put to death because of her.

entries.title: Genesis 26:10
segments: Then Abimelech said, What have you done to us? one of the people might well have had connection with your wife, and the sin would have been ours.

entries.title: Genesis 26:11
segments: And Abimelech gave orders to his people that anyone touching Isaac or his wife was to be put to death.

entries.title: Genesis 26:12
segments: ¶Now Isaac, planting seed in that land, got in the same year fruit a hundred times as much, for the blessing of the Lord was on him.

entries.title: Genesis 26:13
segments: And his wealth became very great, increasing more and more;

entries.title: Genesis 26:14
segments: For he had great wealth of flocks and herds and great numbers of servants; so that the Philistines were full of envy.

entries.title: Genesis 26:15
segments: Now all the water-holes, which his father's servants had made in the days of Abraham, had been stopped up with earth by the Philistines.

entries.title: Genesis 26:16
segments: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are stronger than we are.

entries.title: Genesis 26:17
segments: So Isaac went away from there, and put up his tents in the valley of Gerar, making his living-place there.

entries.title: Genesis 26:18
segments: And he made again the water-holes which had been made in the days of Abraham his father, and which had been stopped up by the Philistines; and he gave them the names which his father had given them.

entries.title: Genesis 26:19
segments: Now Isaac's servants made holes in the valley, and came to a spring of flowing water.

entries.title: Genesis 26:20
segments: But the herdmen of Gerar had a fight with Isaac's herdmen, for they said, The spring is ours: so he gave the spring the name of Esek, because there was a fight about it.

entries.title: Genesis 26:21
segments: Then they made another water-hole, and there was a fight about that, so he gave it the name of Sitnah.

entries.title: Genesis 26:22
segments: Then he went away from there, and made another water-hole, about which there was no fighting: so he gave it the name of Rehoboth, for he said, Now the Lord has made room for us, and we will have fruit in this land.

entries.title: Genesis 26:23
segments: And from there he went on to Beer-sheba.

entries.title: Genesis 26:24
segments: That night the Lord came to him in a vision, and said, I am the God of your father Abraham: have no fear for I am with you, blessing you, and your seed will be increased because of my servant Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 26:25
segments: Then he made an altar there, and gave worship to the name of the Lord, and he put up his tents there, and there his servants made a water-hole.

entries.title: Genesis 26:26
segments: ¶And Abimelech had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol, the captain of his army.

entries.title: Genesis 26:27
segments: And Isaac said to them, Why have you come to me, seeing that in your hate for me you sent me away from you?

entries.title: Genesis 26:28
segments: And they said, We saw clearly that the Lord was with you: so we said, Let there be an oath between us and you, and let us make an agreement with you;

entries.title: Genesis 26:29
segments: That you will do us no damage, even as we put no hand on you, and did you nothing but good, and sent you away in peace: and now the blessing of the Lord is on you.

entries.title: Genesis 26:30
segments: Then he made a feast for them, and they all had food and drink.

entries.title: Genesis 26:31
segments: And early in the morning they took an oath one to the other: then Isaac sent them away and they went on their way in peace.

entries.title: Genesis 26:32
segments: And that day Isaac's servants came to him and gave him word of the water-hole which they had made, and said to him, We have come to water.

entries.title: Genesis 26:33
segments: And he gave it the name of Shibah: so the name of that town is Beer-sheba to this day.

entries.title: Genesis 26:34
segments: ¶And when Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

entries.title: Genesis 26:35
segments: And Isaac and Rebekah had grief of mind because of them.
